observation: The current hardening adds _factory_payload_sha256 and verifies it equals the digest of binding.as_dict(), but both _factory_seal and _factory_payload_sha256 remain normal dataclass init fields. dataclasses.replace() therefore preserves the exact seal identity and permits replacement of _factory_payload_sha256. Because as_dict() excludes both private origin fields, a caller can first replace a lineage-bearing public field, compute the new public digest, then replace _factory_payload_sha256 with that digest. The final object retains the exact factory seal and carries a matching factory-payload digest even though its public lineage no longer equals the factory-produced payload. validate_gwt_event_binding currently calls only assert_reentry_uptake_binding_factory_origin(), so this adaptive replacement can satisfy the consumer-side VSR08 gate without deep source-object revalidation.
reproducer: Start from one valid binding returned by bind_reentry_to_uptake().
Assert forged2._factory_seal is binding._factory_seal and forged2.broadcast_sha256 != binding.broadcast_sha256.

Call assert_reentry_uptake_binding_factory_origin(forged2). Required safe result: FAIL_CLOSED. Current structural semantics predict ACCEPT because seal identity and recomputed payload digest both match.
failure_signature: A post-factory dataclasses.replace object with changed public lineage and adaptively recomputed _factory_payload_sha256 passes assert_reentry_uptake_binding_factory_origin and therefore validate_gwt_event_binding when gwt_ref still matches binding_id.
scope: This does not invalidate validate_reentry_uptake_binding(), which rebuilds from exact WP506/WP507/WP508 source objects and compares canonical public content. It invalidates only seal+digest metadata as standalone proof of non-replaceable factory origin.
required_result_before_g3_terminal_accep: Execute VSR08D against final G3 semantics and fail closed. Prefer reuse of validate_reentry_uptake_binding with exact source evidence at the consumer when those source objects are available. If a lightweight origin token remains necessary, make replacement unable to carry origin metadata through normal dataclass construction/replacement (for example origin fields not participating in __init__/replace and set only by the existing factory) and retain a regression proving adaptive public-field replacement cannot preserve admissible origin. Do not create a second GWT authority.
next_exact_action: WP717 G3 owner should absorb VSR08D before terminal repository acceptance; no VPS dispatch should promote this changed G3 subject until the final repository discriminator suite is green.
